INDEPENDENT DISPOSITION — AMEND exact off-tree SHA-256 91103fd601ef28df54a959345977d8d508b70e19c1578bc71584447baff9d999.

The five second-pass repairs pass at the normative level: conditional source branches, optional coherent draft under Partial, manifest-byte re-read before atomic commit plus honest post-commit findings, typed refusal of mixed V1 ViewBasis, and a complete in-document HTML textual twin independent of preview.txt. O3 is also represented honestly: one common typed packet, Codex-first versus coordinated structural conditions, Tier 1 executable gates separated from Tier 2 human claims. I am not reopening those decisions.

Two internal contradictions remain before this should become a durable candidate.

1. THE ILLUSTRATIVE TYPES STILL ENCODE THE OLD CONTRACT. Section 7.6 says the distinctions are normative, but AcquisitionAccount.source is unconditional SourceIdentities even though section 7.7 and C2 require Constructed versus Refused source branches. SemanticOutcome.Partial carries only gaps even though sections 4.2, 7.3, 7.4.1, 7.7, and C1 permit an optional coherent draft reference. Minimal repair: sketch a closed SourceOutcome and use it in AcquisitionAccount; sketch Partial(gaps, draft: Option[SemanticModelRef]). Exact public names remain unapproved, but the example must make every normative state representable and reject forbidden combinations.

2. THE OPTIONAL PARTIAL-DRAFT CROSS-ROOT LAW IS ASSERTED BUT NOT KILLED BY ITS OWN COURT. C17 exercises validated closure and partial/refused branches with no semantic-model entry. C1 proves a partial draft can exist, but does not run the C17 id/role/length/checksum/media/schema mutations against its reference. Add a partial-with-draft C17 case and apply the same bijective closure mutations. Otherwise an implementation can pass both courts while validating closure only for Validated.

One source-stage clarification would remove a future ambiguity: the refused source branch currently retains at most admitted original identity. Either state that no failure boundary exists after successful decode but before constructed StorySource, or preserve any successfully established decoded identity and receipt in the refusal account. A completed stage should not vanish merely because a later stage failed.

This is a narrow AMEND, not an architectural rejection. No public vocabulary, dependency, code, pin, candidate installation, or landing is authorized by this review.
